# Template: bicycle_drivetrain
A side view of a bicycle drivetrain: a toothed front chainring and a smaller rear cog (sprocket) drawn at their correct relative sizes, joined by a chain that runs along both external tangents, plus the pedal crank, the rear wheel rim with spokes, force/speed arrows, and a gear-ratio caption. Choose this for anything about bicycle gears, gear ratios, chainrings, cassettes, cogs, sprockets, derailleurs, mechanical advantage on a bike, or why a small chainring with a big cog is easier to pedal than a big chainring with a small cog. Teeth counts are params, so you can show a climbing gear vs a top gear by re-rendering with different numbers.
Parameter schema:
{
 "type": "object",
 "properties": {
  "front_teeth": {
   "type": "integer",
   "description": "Teeth on the front chainring (default 52). Sizes are drawn in proportion to the two teeth counts.",
   "minimum": 7,
   "maximum": 80
  },
  "rear_teeth": {
   "type": "integer",
   "description": "Teeth on the rear cog / sprocket (default 16).",
   "minimum": 7,
   "maximum": 80
  },
  "show_chain": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Draw the chain wrapping both sprockets (default true)."
  },
  "show_crank": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Draw the pedal crank arm and pedal (default true)."
  },
  "show_arrows": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Draw the pedal force arrow and the rear-wheel rotation/speed arrow (default true). Turn off for a plain mechanical diagram."
  },
  "show_wheel": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Draw the faint rear wheel rim and spokes behind the cog for context (default true)."
  },
  "show_teeth": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Draw individual teeth on both sprockets (default true)."
  },
  "show_ratio": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Show the gear-ratio caption at the bottom (default true)."
  },
  "front_label": {
   "type": "string",
   "description": "Label for the chainring (default \"52T chainring\" from front_teeth)."
  },
  "rear_label": {
   "type": "string",
   "description": "Label for the rear cog (default \"16T rear cog\" from rear_teeth)."
  },
  "chain_label": {
   "type": "string",
   "description": "Label for the chain (default \"Chain\")."
  },
  "crank_label": {
   "type": "string",
   "description": "Label for the crank arm (default \"Crank arm\")."
  },
  "pedal_label": {
   "type": "string",
   "description": "Label for the pedal force arrow (default \"Pedal force\")."
  },
  "wheel_label": {
   "type": "string",
   "description": "Label for the rear-wheel speed arrow (default \"Wheel N× per pedal\")."
  },
  "ratio_caption": {
   "type": "string",
   "description": "Override the bottom gear-ratio caption text."
  }
 }
}
Element ids your commands can reference:
- wheel_rim: faint rear wheel rim arc
- spokes: the rear wheel spokes (one group)
- chainring: front chainring pitch circle
- chainring_teeth: the chainring's teeth (one group)
- chainring_hub: crank axle / bottom bracket circle
- cog: rear cog pitch circle
- cog_teeth: the rear cog's teeth (one group)
- cog_hub: rear axle circle
- chain: the closed chain loop around both sprockets
- chain_links: the chain link ticks along the two straight runs (one group)
- crank: the crank arm
- pedal: the pedal at the end of the crank
- pedal_arrow: downward force arrow at the pedal
- wheel_arrow: curved rotation/speed arrow around the rear wheel
- ratio_caption: the gear-ratio caption text at the bottom
- label_front / label_rear / label_chain / label_crank / label_pedal_force / label_wheel: the name labels
Examples:
Request: "Draw a bike drivetrain and explain what a gear ratio is." → params: {}
Request: "Why is a small chainring with a big cog easier to pedal? Show a climbing gear." → params: {"front_teeth":34,"rear_teeth":28,"show_arrows":true,"pedal_label":"Less force needed","wheel_label":"Wheel only 1.21× per pedal"}

In YAML: `template: bicycle_drivetrain` and `params:` per the schema above; commands name the element ids above.
